result.summary: Adds guidance to developer documentation on how to reference killed mutants in pull request descriptions and test additions. It establishes conventions for test PRs addressing mutation testing findings.
result.problem: Currently, contributors lack standardized guidelines for referencing which mutation testing mutants are killed by new or extended tests, making PR reviews harder and risking duplicate efforts across contributors.
evidence: PR description: 'The main motivation is to facilitate review, avoid duplicated work (different PRs addressing the same mutants), and go towards an automated setup to check it.'
result.scope_notes: A documentation-only update adding 35 lines to developer-notes.md.
result.card: Adds guidelines to doc/developer-notes.md specifying how contributors should format PR descriptions when adding or extending tests to kill mutants. It aims to streamline review, prevent duplicate contributor efforts on identical mutants, and help prepare for automated verification tooling. This is a developer-facing process documentation update.

risk.why: It only modifies developer documentation notes and cannot affect node operation or binary builds.
